Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated videogame GROUND MODULE, perfectly TOP-DOWN orthographic map texture, no perspective and no camera tilt. The engine will project it at 35 degrees later. Native transparent PNG. An original Yautja-compatible empty landing pad, no ship, no landscape.
Actual footprint 1000 units wide by 760 deep. WIDE RECTANGLE with clipped corners: long left/right edges VERTICAL, front/rear edges HORIZONTAL, opposite sides parallel and exactly equal length. Aspect 1000:760. Center a perfect geometrical CIRCLE landing disc, NOT an ellipse, with subtle segmented bronze rings on charcoal metal. Flush amber guide lights and thin volcanic stone border. No raised side faces or tall objects.
Ground-level pad, no stairs. Clear pedestrian opening at center BOTTOM/SOUTH edge, no barrier across it. No H, arrows, letters or readable symbols. Even diffuse lighting, no shadows from surroundings, no haze. Fit the complete pad into 1536 by 1280 with transparent margin. Detailed hand-painted realistic surface. Strict top-down: circle circular, rectangle parallel, genuine alpha outside.
